mentions.name: Appreciate
mentions.description: Appreciate is a motivational reminder app designed to counter habituation, with a macOS version currently tested extensively.
mentions.problem: Habituation — getting used to things so they no longer spark motivation, which the reminders aim to counter.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started working on an "anti-habituation" motivational reminder app:

https://appreciate.srid.ca/

https://github.com/srid/Appreciate
